actions.action: Rinse plants with lukewarm water in sink/shower, focusing on undersides, every 3 days for 2 weeks
Spray insecticidal soap labeled for edibles on all leaf undersides and stems, every 5-7 days for 3 weeks
Inspect leaf undersides and tips twice a week and squash any aphids
Rinse leaves well before eating and observe soap label waiting time

reason: The answer correctly identifies aphids and leads with rinsing under water plus regular checks and squashing, which matches the fix that worked; the added insecticidal soap is safe for edibles and not harmful.
